pathogen.value: Avian metaavulavirus 2 (formerly Avian paramyxovirus 2), a paramyxovirus

value: spreads slowly between flocks, likely from contact with infected wild birds
exact route between domestic birds is not well defined
mild or no respiratory symptoms in chickens
more severe sinus infection and dropped egg production reported in turkeys
keeping domestic flocks separated from wild birds (bird-proofing housing)

summary.value: Avian metaavulavirus 2 is a paramyxovirus mainly found in turkeys and wild birds, and chickens are usually only mildly affected or show no symptoms. It spreads slowly, likely from contact with wild birds, and prevention centers on keeping domestic flocks away from wild bird contact.
